independent_replication_units: 2 early and 2 late libraries; four cross-pair differences are correlated
level_transform: observed conditional mean of log1p-normalized positives
mean_definition: equal-library late mean minus equal-library early mean
unsupported_behavior: exact parent values; never force carrier fallback for an unmeasured gene or unsupported group
positive_quantiles: full empirical positive order statistics at midpoint ranks; linear interpolation at target midpoint ranks then (1-w_level)*carrier+w_level*parent
one_side_empty_positive_values: use the nonempty side's observed positive distribution; both empty stays zero
recipient_ranking: parent expression primary, paired carrier expression breaks parent ties, immutable original within-state row order breaks remaining ties
ambient_and_stress_masks: inherit frozen GSE230531 global and non-CM ambient mask; masked genes stay exact parent
controls: weights all one gives exact v0094
weights all zero reproduce v0051 state-gene margins
source_local_metrics: full32,285-gene diagnostic against released E9.5; not future accuracy
scientific_claim: descriptive source-uncertainty regularization, not calibrated biological confidence
